acceptanceCriteria: spec and code agree on the languages registry-export-unresolved covers, with a Ruby fixture pinning the choice
an ambient `declare const require` either resolves lazy entries or the widening is recorded as intended in the spec
body: Residuals from the registry dialect lane (PR #960, 2026-10-16). (1) The registry-export-unresolved widening reason is also emitted for Ruby changed paths, while the NGI-V0 spec text says JS/TS only: either the spec or the code is wrong. (2) A TypeScript `declare const require: ...` ambient declaration is treated as a shadowed require, so lazy entries widen (conservative, but a precision loss).
title: registry-export-unresolved fires for Ruby paths although NGI-V0 scopes it to JS/TS, and a TS `declare const require` makes lazy entries widen
